## Notes

Paradox Development Studio, Paradox Interactive, 2022-10-25; Windows, macOS, Linux. Set 1836 to 1936, over 100 playable countries. Interest groups such as the Devout, Industrialists, and Rural Folk with affiliation based on economic status; industrialization by building mines and factories; world market trading; laws such as Free Trade and Laissez-Faire; diplomatic plays with demands, counter-demands, a mobilization countdown, and war if unresolved.
